title: On four network monitoring parameters in graphs and their gaps
summary: Let \( G \) be a finite simple undirected graph. Four graph parameters related to network monitoring are the \emph{geodetic set}, \emph{edge geodetic set}, \emph{strong edge geodetic set}, and \emph{monitoring edge geodetic set}, with corresponding minimum sizes, denoted by \( g(G), eg(G), seg(G) \), and \( meg(G) \), respectively. These parameters quantify the minimum number of vertices required to monitor all vertices and edges of \( G \) under progressively stricter path-based conditions.
